id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Looks like a dead end. There were no other paths... What, there's nothing here!
"Too bad, Atsuo. Let's leave before the lava cooks us medium rare...
"A voice from under the ground...! Brother, there's something below...!
"That's the man-eating fire dragon...! But wasn't it slain by Miko!?
"...Miko was hiding this. She couldn't slay the dragon, so she hid it and deceived everyone!
"Mum being the sacrifice is all this thing's fault...!
"We can't stay! We must tell everyone quickly! ...Brother, let's go back to the village!"
